notes: Typescript page 15 closes the discussion of computation. It records a practical limit N=43000, describes IJMODK and Dr. Don Russell’s implementation, asks for easier extraction of integer remainders, and says that programs run in 1964 exposed a low-probability timing fault. “timing” is inserted above the line. The word “hope” concerns computer design; there is no mathematical proof marked as unverified here. The manuscript provides no implementation from which the routine or hardware claims could be checked. The ambiguous second argument is not inferred from programming practice. The overwritten afft/e cell is read as t corrected to e, with the sequence of impressions less certain than their identity.
